description: This Go source file defines Prometheus metrics for Kubernetes rest client, including histograms, counters, and gauges for request latency, sizes, retries, and plugin TTLs, with registration and adapter implementations.

classes.name: latencyAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for observing request latency histograms.

classes.name: resolverLatencyAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for observing DNS resolver latency histograms.

classes.name: sizeAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for observing request and response size histograms.

classes.name: resultAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for incrementing request result counters.

classes.name: expiryToTTLAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for tracking certificate TTL expiry.

classes.name: rotationAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for observing certificate rotation durations.

classes.name: policyAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for counting plugin policy comparisons.

classes.name: transportCacheAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for observing transport cache entries.

classes.name: transportCacheCallsAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for counting transport cache creation calls.

methods.name: Observe
methods.description: Method for recording histogram observations (latency, rotation).

methods.name: Increment
methods.description: Method for incrementing counters (request results, plugin calls).

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Method for setting gauge values (certificate TTL, cache entries).

methods.name: IncrementRetry
methods.description: Method for counting retries with context.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Method for setting expiry time in TTL adapter.
